scope: Classic fixed linear-risk calibration diagnostic on already-seen development images; no prospective evidence, GPU, retraining, model search or adaptive selector
preprocess: DIV2K_train_HR native center128 crop, PIL RGB float32/255, torch CPU avg_pool2d2 to RGB64; same operation order as old development. No resizing. Shave4 has P=3136 pixels.

operator_gate.integer_and_mask_arrays: dtype+shape+bytes exact equality, as is original B; W absolute maxdifference<=1e-14
operator_gate.all24_arrays_and_record_sha: Verify against old prediction_cohort.json; read no old scores, development Y/truth, old FF prediction or posterior metadata before new recommendation freeze

law: The common finite empirical ensemble uniformly weights 32 calibration images and their3 RGB channels. Channels are not independent samples. Mean is fixed .5, not estimated; there are no iid confidence intervals or natural-image Gaussian validity claims.
risk: For each fixed operator, Rcal=mean over32 images,3 channels,P=3136 targets of [.5+Wcrop*(calobs-.5)-caltarget]^2 + 1e-4/P * ||Wcrop||_F^2. Store each image's bias, common noise and total. Cross-check via the low-rank residual matrix Wcrop*Zo-Zt, with96 image-channel columns; never form full4096-square covariance.
recommendations: argmin Rcal, ties within absolute1e-12 of numerical minimum broken by ascending lexicographic(method,sigma,phase). Produce all12 operator risks; perphase4-arm choices (3), permethod/sigma3-phase choices (4), global12-arm choice (1). All are target-independent calibration-static; no development observation or truth affects choices.
freeze: Freeze source/protocol identities, all24 verified operator archives,12 reference W hashes, all32 source image hashes, calibration per-image risks and all recommendations before reading development truth/old scores/posterior metadata. Recheck frozen file hashes before post-hoc score.
score: Postfreeze: use saved W with clean/truth to compute fixed deterministic expected raw risk=bias^2+noise term; use old control scores for realized clamped MSE/PSNR only. Compare calibration recommendation versus expected-raw oracle, its regret/match, all66 pair gap signs per development image and preserve every opposing pair. Baselines perphase: fixed RBFsigma3 and own-prior posterior shave4 variance argmin among4 arms (diagnostic only, read after freeze). Do not apply raw linear risk identity to clamped outputs.
limits: Calibration empirical law need not transfer to the2 development images
Calibration data are training split, but this diagnostic was designed after seeing development outcomes
Different means, priors, regularization and optimization confound old nonlinear FF comparisons
Horizontal phase sets are nonnested; vertical stride4 remains; no scalar fill-distance causal explanation
Own-prior posterior is not calibrated actual risk
failure: Newroot only. Per-input, per-calibration-image/arm and per-score journals; finite checks, complete cohort and frozen hashes required. Failure/partial files and missing ids retained. Every image/arm/score and final COMPLETE has budget checkpoint. External launcher timeout guard required. No changed-source continuation.
cost: Invocation wall, CPU-phase wall, user/system CPU seconds, peak RSS, source verification, calibration preprocessing and perarm compute, equivalence, recommendation/freeze and scoring times. Shared CPU timings are not exclusive benchmarks. No recomputing W or solves.
